title: Settle-up direction and dead end, group amount edit (mobile + web), move-to-group refresh, iPhone edit keypad

acceptance_criteria.outcome: On mobile, opening settle-up from a balance row or the People tab takes payer, payee and amount from the suggested transfers between the viewer and that member; with no such transfer, nothing can be recorded.

Editing only the amount (or other text) of a manual group expense on mobile saves; the server keeps and rescales the stored payers and split. A single payer's amount follows the edited total when payers or split are changed too.
After a personal expense is moved to a group, the mobile Expenses list and other expense-derived views refresh without a manual reload.
In the iOS personal expense edit sheet, with the number pad open, the header stays on screen and one tap on a visible Save Changes saves.
On web, editing a group expense without changing payers or split saves without redoing the split and leaves the stored split to the server (rescaled for a new amount).

Mobile Settle up (button and own row) never opens a sheet without a payer and payee: outgoing transfers are listed, a single incoming one is pre-filled, several incoming ones ask who paid, none says so.

On mobile, Settle up and group expense edit read a comma or dot as the decimal mark (12,50 is 12.50) and record nothing for text that could be read as a different amount, such as 1,234.50, 1,234 or three decimals; the button, payment links and recorded value agree.
